# Research Toolkit - Curtin Library

> Comprehensive research support platform providing guidance on planning, data management, publishing, and impact measurement for Curtin University researchers.

The Research Toolkit is Curtin Library's central hub for research skills development, offering practical guides and tools for all stages of the research lifecycle. It supports HDR students and researchers through programs like GRASP (Graduate Research Advanced Skills Program) and provides access to specialized tools for data collection, analysis, and open access publishing.

## Key Topics

- Research Data Management
- Data Storage Solutions
- Open Access Publishing
- ORCID Identifiers
- Author Identifiers
- Research Impact Measurement
- Copyright Guidance
- Data Publication
- Thesis Writing
- HDR Students
- Scholarly Publishing
- Research Planning
- Sensitive Data
- Data Management Tools

## Research Planning & Preparation

- [Planning - Research Toolkit](https://researchtoolkit.library.curtin.edu.au/planning): Guide to research planning, data management, and copyright considerations before starting research.

## Data Management & Analysis

- [Data - Research Toolkit](https://researchtoolkit.library.curtin.edu.au/data): Core resource for data collection, analysis, and management using SPSS, NVivo, and Qualtrics tools.
- [Data Storage Explorer](https://researchtoolkit.library.curtin.edu.au/data/data-storage-explorer): Interactive tool comparing data storage solutions including OneDrive, REDCap, and CDL environments.

## Publishing & Open Access

- [Publishing - Research Toolkit](https://researchtoolkit.library.curtin.edu.au/publishing): Guide to publishing strategy, open access, and deposit tools including espace and Elements.

## Research Impact & Metrics

- [Impact - Research Toolkit](https://researchtoolkit.library.curtin.edu.au/impact): Guide to measuring and tracking research impact using author identifiers, DOI, and metrics tools.

## Getting Started

- [Research Toolkit Homepage](https://researchtoolkit.library.curtin.edu.au): Homepage for Curtin Library's research support toolkit with guides on publishing, copyright, and research skills.
